## Live browser push mechanism

**Server-side:** Server-Sent Events over HTTP. Authenticated clients open `GET /api/v1/sse`; the handler subscribes to a shared in-process hub and streams JSON events as `data: …\n\n` frames (with heartbeats).

| Layer | Path | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Hub | `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` | `SSEHub` — `Subscribe` / `Unsubscribe` / `Broadcast`; visibility-filtered fan-out to client channels |
| HTTP endpoint | `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` | `RegisterSSERoutes` → `handleSSE` — auth, `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, read from `client.events`, flush |
| Wiring | `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:57,125` | `NewSSEHub()` on `APIV1Service`; `RegisterSSERoutes(gwGroup, s.SSEHub, …)` |
| Shutdown | `server/server.go:77` | Server holds `apiV1Service.SSEHub` for lifecycle |

**Client-side:** `web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts` — `fetch("/api/v1/sse", { Accept: "text/event-stream", Authorization: Bearer … })`, parse `data:` lines, invalidate React Query memo/user caches. Mounted from `web/src/main.tsx:49`.
